verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Spirit Ball as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 300 Ki, with projectile, tracking, additional-input, long-range, and 1-18-hit characteristics.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Spirit Ball is taught by Yamcha as the reward for Lesson 3 of his mentor training. Independent guide documentation also identifies Lesson 3 as the Spirit Ball lesson and reward.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because this is a mentor-training reward and no Ultimate Finish condition applies.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Spirit Ball is kept distinct from Spirit Bomb, Super Spirit Bomb, and DUAL Spirit Ball.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact per-hit damage is not promoted as a canonical database value because observed damage depends on character stats and version conditions.

records.name: Spirit Ball
records.character_source: Yamcha; Tien - Customize Partner; Cell (Perfect) - Customize Partner
records.skill_description: Attack with a powerful Ki Blast you control.
records.mechanics_notes: The user creates and throws a large Ki ball. Additional input can make the projectile continue tracking the opponent, with the current reference documenting up to 18 hits. The skill is a long-range projectile and is distinct from the similarly named Spirit Bomb techniques.
